reportedIssues: The restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” cuts off the third restaurant card, including its title and delivery price, at the right viewport edge. While this may indicate horizontal scrolling, it can look like content is unintentionally truncated.
The final category chip is only visible as a thin partial shape on the right edge, making the category row appear abruptly clipped.
The second card in “Popular right now” is largely obscured below the fixed bottom navigation in this viewport, so its restaurant information is not visible without scrolling.

expected.reasoning: No reported issue describes a discount badge displaying −0% or any badge/discount-related defect; all reported issues concern layout clipping and viewport overflow.
